title: Installment Payment Plans: Closing, Refund, Final Bill and Collection Schedule
content:
Accounts receivable figures for closing a plan of the **Installment Payment Plans** are identical on all six plans, from the Cardinal Point Paid-in-Full Plan to the Cardinal Point Monthly Card Autopay Plan.

| Item | Figure on every plan |
|---|---|
| Refund of a credit balance after the plan closes | within 15 calendar days |
| Refund method | to the original card or bank account; otherwise by check to the mailing address |
| Largest debit balance written off instead of final-billed after a cancellation | 10.00 |
| Final bill due | 20 calendar days after the final bill date |
| Referral of an unpaid final balance to the collection agency | after 30 calendar days past the final bill due date |
| Final-billed plan reactivated when its policy term is reinstated | yes |
| Installments after reactivation | unbilled installments keep their original due dates |

**Worked boundary (hypothetical dates).** A final bill dated the 1st of a month falls due on the 21st, 20 calendar days later. A final balance still unpaid 30 calendar days after the 21st is referred to the collection agency; on the 30th day after the due date it has not yet passed that point.

**Small balances.** After a cancellation, a remaining debit balance of 10.00 or less is written off rather than final-billed; a debit balance of 10.01 is final-billed.
